title: ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer
description:
ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a professional for the Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Technical Authority (MOC/TA & Governance)
    • Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with MODEC standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT).
    • Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned.
    • Ensure full documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement (Condition Monitoring)
    • Monitor rotating equipment performance using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection.
    • Oversee and perform Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
    • Develop and implement condition‑based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime.
  • Reliability Engineering (RCM/Strategy/MTBF)
    • Develop and implement reliability and maintenance strategies (RCM), with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost.
    • Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and Dry Gas Seal systems; recommend corrective actions.
    • Identify and manage “bad actors,” drive elimination plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Lead RCA for failures and recurring issues using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify effectiveness of actions.
    • Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements.
  • Troubleshooting & Technical Support
    • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance to resolve machinery issues, unplanned shutdowns, and control/operating parameter optimizations.
    • Offer guidance for commissioning/start‑up, operations, overhauls, and controls/monitoring upgrades for rotating equipment.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Projects (Design Review & Installations)
    • Support capital projects by reviewing specifications for maintainability and reliability and ensuring correct installation/alignment per API/AGMA/ISO.
    • Support preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. MBA/Postgraduate in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus.
  • Experience in rotating equipment operations, maintenance, or reliability in Oil & Gas (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services.
  • Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and failure diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and field condition monitoring experience.
  • Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machinery design, lubrication, mechanical seals (incl. Dry Gas Seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis.
  • Working knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816);
  • Deep understanding of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal systems, and gearboxes.
  • Vibration analysis certification (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desired; oil analysis/thermography certifications are advantageous.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with CMMS (SAP preferred) and machinery/condition monitoring software.
  • OSIsoft PI System and System 1 knowledge is differential. Advanced Microsoft Office: Power BI is a plus.
  • Advanced English.
  • Active CREA (as applicable for Brazil).

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements.
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sr
description:
A área de engenharia de dados deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da Vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados, otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos;
  • Implantar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz(tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem;

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager;
  • DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra);
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos;
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes;
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual;
  • Convênio Farmácia. Descontos de até 85%;
  • Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev - variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário;
  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação;
  • Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias);
  • Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios;
  • Auxílio-Educacional - Para dependentes até o ensino médio;
  • TotalPass;
  • Assinatura Solar - Possibilidade de obter desconto especial na conta de energia a partir da adesão a um plano de geração distribuída;
  • Clube Smiles Corporativo - Descontos de até 50% nos planos oferecidos para você planejar suas viagens. Disponível também para cônjuge e filhos 18+;
  • Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.

Desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem: Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo;
  • Recrutamento Interno: Divulgação das vagas disponíveis em todo Brasil, incentivando a mobilidade interna.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com opropósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;

Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;

Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;

Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;

Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);

Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;

Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;

Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão:

  • Elaborar planos e executar manutenções.
  • Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos.
  • Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos.
  • Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Informática Básica.
  • Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica-cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral-proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub(Gympass)-incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.
  • Telemedicina: Dra.AON| Conexa Saúde-apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar.

  • Comissionamento- variável conforme a performance eprodutividade.

Para sua comodidade a empresa também oferece Vale Transporte e Uniforme.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in software development who can design and evolve modern architectures, lead engineers through best practices, and collaborate directly with client stakeholders on solution design and technical decisions. You will set engineering standards for the team, perform code reviews, coach developers, and ensure we deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Define and evolve application architectures (monoliths, microservices, event‑driven), ensuring clear domain boundaries, integration patterns, and API contracts.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision‑making, balancing trade‑offs across scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Ensure non‑functional requirements (reliability, observability, security, and performance) are embedded throughout design and delivery.
  • Drive the development of high‑quality .NET services and APIs, setting technical direction for standards, versioning, and documentation.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD alignment, clean and secure coding standards.
  • Act as a technical leader, mentoring the team, fostering continuous learning, and enabling scalable, observable solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in software development and AI experience.
  • Solid architectural knowledge (DDD, CQRS, monolith vs. microservices, event‑driven systems).
  • Proven technical leadership, including code reviews, branching strategies, and guidance on best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core, API design, async programming, relational databases).
  • Experience with cloud environments, containers, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of observability and security fundamentals.
  • Experience collaborating with front‑end teams and applying modern testing practices.
  • Ability to discuss solutions with client architects, negotiate trade‑offs, and justify decisions.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The specific and existing team takes care of the sales of industrial steam turbines in Latin America in different industries up to a size of 250 MWe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met optimally and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards

  • Supportive work culture and a healthy work‑life balance
  • Flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Flexible benefits and savings programs
  • Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell vacation
  • Parental leave

title: Knowledge Management Technical Author
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical communication, knowledge structuring and collaboration are essential to enabling engineering excellence?

Would you enjoy transforming complex technical information into accessible, clear and high‑quality documentation that supports teams across a global organization?

Join our Knowledge Management Team!

At Baker Hughes, Knowledge Management (KM) is essential for accelerating learning, promoting collaboration, and ensuring that expertise is captured and shared across the organization. Our KM team drives digital collaboration tools, documentation excellence, and user‑centric solutions that support engineering, technology and business functions.

Partner with the best!

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will collaborate with engineers, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop high‑quality technical documentation and maintain digital KM platforms—primarily based on SharePoint. You will help shape a business‑wide system that enables collaboration, governance and efficiency across Flexible Pipe Systems (FPS) and other OFSE teams.

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will be responsible for:

Technical Writing & Content Development

  • Researching and gathering knowledge from engineers and technical specialists to understand complex products, processes and systems.
  • Producing clear, concise and technically accurate documentation including manuals, guides, communication materials, instructions and support resources.
  • Applying translation responsibilities (English Portuguese) across the department.
  • Reviewing, editing and simplifying existing documents to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity.
  • Creating diagrams, illustrations, screenshots and other visuals to support engineering explanations.

Knowledge Management & Content Governance

  • Updating and maintaining libraries of technical information within CMS platforms and KM repositories.
  • Ensuring documentation aligned with Baker Hughes standards remains up‑to‑date, correct and consistent.
  • Supporting implementation of KM methodologies, continuous improvement and Lean practices.
  • Identifying and eliminating roadblocks to knowledge sharing while promoting best practices.

SharePoint & Digital Collaboration

  • Creating, managing and updating SharePoint content, pages, templates and tools used across FPS.
  • Supporting system efficiency through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinating upgrades, improvements and fixes within the KM environment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Consulting

  • Meeting with teams to develop documentation, templates and SharePoint content aligned with business needs.
  • Reviewing new materials with users and experts to ensure relevance and quality.
  • Partnering closely with FPS Chief Engineers’ Office and global KM teams.
  • Advising on document formatting, intellectual property, branding, confidentiality classifications and export control requirements.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • Have fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Have proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Author or similar documentation‑focused role.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge Management principles and methodologies.
  • Have proficiency in MS Office and adaptability to digital tools used for documentation and collaboration.
  • Have experience with SharePoint (coding knowledge is beneficial but not required).
  • Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry or an equivalent technical sector.
  • Have excellent written communication skills with strong attention to detail and clarity.
  • Have the ability to learn complex technical topics and participate in technical discussions.
  • Have the ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Have familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE).
  • Have an understanding of the Engineering Lifecycle.
  • Willingness to travel internationally if required (desirable).
  • Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable).

Work in a way that works for you

In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from 7am-4pm or 8am-5pm.
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working for you

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs

About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

Esta posição faz parte do nosso time Comercial, responsável por impulsionar o crescimento da 99 por meio da aquisição de novos restaurantes e da expansão da nossa presença em bairros estratégicos de São Paulo. Os BDRs da 99 não são apenas vendedores - são o rosto da nossa marca. Estão no campo, conversando com donos de restaurantes, entendendo suas dores e mostrando como a 99 pode transformar suas operações. O time Comercial atua em ritmo acelerado, combinando direcionamento orientado por dados com construção prática de relacionamento. Trabalhamos em parceria com Sales Operations e Produto para garantir que abordemos os restaurantes certos, com a mensagem certa, e oferecemos uma experiência de onboarding simples e eficiente. O candidato ideal se destaca em ambientes dinâmicos, gosta de estar em campo e traz alta energia, excelente comunicação e forte senso de responsabilidade em cada interação.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Customer DevelopmentFocus on Brazil's local catering formats (fine dining, fast food, coffee, baking, etc.). Explore potential customer resources through diversified methods such as market research, personal referrals, cold calls and visits, industry exhibitions and channel cooperation, and establish and improve a complete customer information database.
  • Sales ConversionCommunicate in depth with customers to accurately identify their needs in core scenarios including food delivery order management, in-store cash register management, member marketing, supply chain collaboration, rider order management and data reports. Combine the advantages of the company's SaaS products and be fully responsible for product demonstration, business negotiation and contract finalization throughout the process.
  • Customer MaintenanceEstablish and maintain long-term cooperative relationships with core customers, conduct regular customer follow-ups, and respond promptly to customer inquiries, complaints and product optimization suggestions. Coordinate internal resources to solve customer problems efficiently, and improve customer satisfaction, retention rate as well as repurchase and upsell rates.
  • Market InsightConduct in-depth research on the development trends of Brazil's local catering and retail industries, systematically collect dynamic information of competitors such as product details, pricing strategies and marketing activities. Compile professional market analysis reports and share them with the company to provide data support for product iteration and sales strategy optimization.
  • Data ManagementStrictly follow the company's management norms to file and update customer visit records, sales data, signed documents and other materials in real time, ensuring the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of data in the CRM system.
  • Team CollaborationStrive to achieve regional sales targets, actively participate in team sales training and experience sharing sessions. Assist the team in building a sales methodology adapted to the Brazilian market and contribute to the overall performance improvement of the team.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational BackgroundBachelor's degree or above; outstanding candidates with college degrees will be considered on a case-by-case basis. No major restrictions, and Portuguese-related majors are preferred.
  • Language ProficiencyFluent in Portuguese listening, speaking, reading and writing, capable of independently completing the full-process business communication with local Brazilian customers; basic English communication skills are a plus.
  • Work ExperienceFresh graduates are welcome to apply; candidates with experience in To B SaaS product sales or catering/retail merchant development (e.g., POS system, catering management software, local life service platform BD) are preferred. For those familiar with Brazil's local business environment and with catering/retail merchant resources, the experience requirements may be appropriately relaxed.
  • Goal-Oriented & Pressure ResistanceStrong goal orientation, excellent self-motivation and pressure resistance, courage to break through sales targets, and ability to adapt to the performance assessment rhythm of the sales position.
  • Learning AbilityStrong fast learning ability, capable of efficiently mastering SaaS product knowledge and catering industry trends, and iterating personal professional capabilities according to market changes.
  • Other Requirements:Good team spirit, ability to adapt to short-term business trips in Brazil, and willingness to deeply cultivate the Brazilian market for a long time and expand local business with the company.

You’ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that's why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Benefits

Why Join Coderio?

At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a remote-first company, passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification.
  • Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls.
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting.
  • Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions.
  • Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios.
  • Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards.
  • Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost).
  • Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.
  • Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting.

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional)

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent).
  • Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets).
  • Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations.
  • High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset.
  • Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.

Compensation

Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits.

Descrição da vaga

Cuidar também é viabilizar, planejar e transformar.

Somos a Rede Américas, um grupo hospitalar robusto que tem como propósito a Paixão por Cuidar.

No Corporativo, apoiamos quem está na linha de frente com gestão estratégica, agilidade e inovação. Trabalhamos juntos(as) para gerar impacto real e sustentável. Aqui, você encontra uma carreira que conecta propósito e resultado nos bastidores do cuidado.

Temos um compromisso com a Diversidade!

Na Rede Américas, acolher, respeitar e valorizar cada pessoa faz parte do nosso compromisso com um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e com real senso de pertencimento. Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todas as identidades e vivências porque equipes plurais constroem um cuidado mais completo, humano e transformador.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar na implantação e disseminação da cultura da empresa;

  • Apoiar na disseminação e manutenção da diversidade e inclusão na organização;

  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores relacionados a áreas, subsidiando as lideranças e diretores da unidade;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar a equipe nos processos de recrutamento e seleção da unidade, buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos, visando atender cada vez melhor a necessidade da unidade;
  • Facilitar a gestão do clima organizacional, desdobrando a Pesquisa de Clima, apoiando na elaboração de ações setoriais e institucionais, visando a melhoria do meio com os colaboradores;
  • Acompanhar a supervisão da área de capacitação e desenvolvimento, na elaboração e implantação dos processos e políticas relacionados e desempenho e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores;
  • Acompanhar, propor e facilitar as ações e processo de Segurança e medicina do trabalho, no que visa melhorar a saúde ocupacional e qualidade de vida do colaborador, garantindo o cumprimento das legislações vigentes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Se você acredita que o cuidado começa com preparo e intenção, esse pode ser o seu lugar.

Para cuidar com a gente, é importante ter:

  • Formação superior completo;
  • Pós graduação desejável;
  • Experiência em atendimento como Business Partner será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos generalista nas disciplinas de Recursos Humanos;
  • Vivência em Change Management, com forte capacidade para desenvolver planos e transformá-los em ação, promovendo engajamento nos processos de Mudanças e Inovação;
  • Pacote office (Word, Excel e Power Point).

Informações adicionais

Nosso cuidado começa dentro de casa, entregando o melhor para as nossas pessoas.

Na Rede Américas, valorizamos quem constrói o cuidado no dia a dia. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios pensados para o seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.

Confira:

  • Cuidados com a alimentação: Vale-alimentação, vale-refeição ou refeitório no local (de acordo com a unidade);
  • Cuidados com a saúde: Plano de saúde e Seguro de vida;
  • Cuidados com o seu desenvolvimento: Academia Américas, Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Carreira, Academia de Cultura e Programa Crescer dentro da Rede Américas;
  • Outros: Vale Transporte, benefícios SESC e programas de reconhecimento.

Só na Rede Américas tem o Programa Bem Cuidar , pautado nos pilares de saúde física, mental e emocional. Nossas linhas de cuidado são pensadas para o bem-estar das nossas pessoas, promovendo hábitos saudáveis, prevenindo doenças e contribuindo para a redução do estresse.

Confira:

  • Saúde mental e emocional: atendimento e acolhimento psicossocial especializado com psicólogos, psiquiatras e assistente social, de acordo com a necessidade de cuidado de cada pessoa;
  • Assistência social: acolhimento social remoto através de assistente social para demandas de inseguranças financeiras, problemas de saúde, orientações sobre benefícios sociais, dentre outras;
  • Para Gestantes: acompanhamento com equipe multidisciplinar e rodas de conversa mensais;
  • Qualidade de vida : com oTotalPass, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas com condições especiais. Mais saúde e bem-estar para o seu dia a dia;
  • Campanhas de saúde: ações mensais de conscientização com base em dados de gestão de saúde, focadas em prevenção e promoção de hábitos saudáveis;
  • Acompanhamento Oncológico: Conjunto de ações para acolhimento, orientações e apoio psicossocial a colaboradores em tratamento oncológico, promovendo maior bem-estar e suporte durante o tratamento.

*Os benefícios podem sofrer alterações de acordo com a região da vaga e da marca.

Se o cuidado também é a sua paixão, aqui é o seu lugar. Candidate-se e construa uma carreira que conecta propósito e prática.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build production‑grade applications on a multi‑tenant SaaS platform handling regulated healthcare data. You will work across .NET 8/9 and React + TypeScript, designing ASP.NET Core APIs and Azure‑hosted multi‑portal frontends, with AI‑assisted development tools integrated into the engineering workflow.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and maintain high‑quality fullstack applications using modern technologies;
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code across both frontend and backend systems;
  • Define and implement best practices for leveraging AI models to review, analyze, and improve code quality;
  • Use AI tools to enhance development workflows and engineering productivity;
  • Evaluate and implement AI‑assisted development approaches across the engineering lifecycle;
  • Collaborate with other engineers to improve development standards, code reviews, and technical architecture;
  • Take ownership of technical solutions and drive engineering excellence across projects.

Must Haves

  • Recent, hands‑on production experience with .NET 8 or 9 within the last two years;
  • Experience designing and building RESTful services using ASP.NET Core Web API that serve multi‑portal frontends;
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core against PostgreSQL ;
  • Experience with async, event‑driven patterns using Azure Service Bus or an equivalent message queue;
  • Comfort designing service boundaries and contracts;
  • Experience with multi‑tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation, audit trails, and configurable role models;
  • Recent production experience with React + TypeScript for component‑driven, multi‑portal applications;
  • Experience building mobile‑responsive UX;
  • Experience building or contributing to a shared frontend architecture;
  • Deep Angular experience does not substitute for React production experience;
  • Experience with Azure as the primary cloud, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Key Vault, Azure Service Bus, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Cache for Redis, and Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server;
  • Experience with Azure DevOps end‑to‑end, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, and familiarity with Azure Boards;
  • Experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code;
  • Experience with Azure Entra ID for SSO/SAML, enterprise identity, JWT, and RBAC patterns;
  • HIPAA‑aware engineering, including encryption, audit trails, minimum necessary access, and careful PHI handling;
  • Healthcare or regulated‑data background is strongly preferred;
  • Experience using Claude Code or equivalent agentic tools for end‑to‑end feature development;
  • Discipline around AI‑generated code, including PR‑based review, automated test gates, and eval‑driven development;
  • Comfort working in a C# + Claude Code loop;
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

Nice to Haves

  • Python (FastAPI) production experience;
  • Familiarity with vector stores, LLM integration patterns, and prompt evals;
  • Experience with hexagonal architecture, TDD, and clean code instincts;
  • Experience integrating with payer or Medicaid systems;
  • Experience with feature flag systems such as LaunchDarkly or PostHog;
  • SOC 2 or StateRAMP experience;
  • Experience working in a PE‑backed scale‑up environment with steering‑group cadence.

Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Nice to Have

Home office; Competitive compensation based on experience; Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company; International Projects; Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational); Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass; Games and Competitions.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Technical Product Owner

As a Technical Product Owner at Swapcard, you will lead a squad of engineers, owning your product area end to end, from roadmap strategy to shipped features. You will talk to clients and end‑users, to internal sales and success teams, dig into usage data, and translate what you learn into a clear, prioritized backlog. You will write user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can actually build from. You will make the hard calls on what to build next, balancing new capabilities, technical debt, and bug fixes based on real customer impact. You will also be deeply involved in the technical side, understanding system constraints, discussing architecture trade‑offs with your developers, and working with designers to make sure what’s feasible is also what’s right for users. This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just manage a backlog.

What you will bring

  • 4+ years of product ownership (or a similar product role) in a software development environment. You’ve shipped features, managed trade‑offs, and worked closely with engineering teams.
  • A technical foundation. Whether through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or through hands‑on experience—you understand how software systems work and can hold your own in technical discussions.
  • Strong analytical skills. You make decisions with data: feature feasibility, prioritization, success measurement. You validate assumptions before committing your team’s time.
  • Excellent prioritization instincts. You know how to sequence work across new features, technical debt, and bugs in a way that maximizes customer value.

How will you work

  • You are curious and proactive, you dig into technical systems, ask why often, and don’t wait to be told what to explore.
  • You collaborate naturally with engineers on architecture, designers on feasibility, and stakeholders on strategy. No silos.
  • You lead with empathy. You care about the people on your team as much as the product you’re building together.
  • You communicate clearly in English, our working language.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building AI‑powered features, payment systems, analytics dashboards, or website/page builders.
  • Familiarity with the events industry or marketplace platforms.

Benefits & Reasons To Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities.
  • Remote‑first policy with headquarters in Paris.
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities.
  • Open‑mind culture that appreciates differences.
  • Feedback‑driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset.
  • Generous paid time off to ensure you have time for what matters most.
  • Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience.
  • In‑person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements.
  • 100 % of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard.
  • Work‑from‑home budget for equipment.
  • Co‑working space budget to support remote work in professional environments.
  • Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills.
  • Mental health care initiatives to support your well‑being.

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit‑based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

WHY JOIN US

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build production-grade applications on a multi-tenant SaaS platform handling regulated healthcare data. You will work across .NET 8/9 and React + TypeScript, designing ASP.NET Core APIs and Azure-hosted multi-portal frontends, with AI-assisted development tools integrated into the engineering workflow.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality fullstack applications using modern technologies;
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code across both frontend and backend systems;
  • Define and implement best practices for leveraging AI models to review, analyze, and improve code quality;

  • Collaborate with other engineers to improve development standards, code reviews, and technical architecture;

MUST HAVES

  • Recent, hands‑on production experience with .NET 8 or 9 within the last two years;
  • Experience designing and building RESTful services using ASP.NET Core Web API that serve multi-portal frontends;
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core against PostgreSQL ;
  • Experience with async, event-driven patterns using Azure Service Bus or an equivalent message queue;
  • Comfort designing service boundaries and contracts;
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation, audit trails, and configurable role models;
  • Recent production experience with React + TypeScript for component-driven, multi-portal applications;
  • Experience building mobile-responsive UX;
  • Experience building or contributing to a shared frontend architecture;
  • Deep Angular experience does not substitute for React production experience;
  • Experience with Azure as the primary cloud, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Key Vault, Azure Service Bus, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Cache for Redis, and Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server;
  • Experience with Azure DevOps end-to-end, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, and familiarity with Azure Boards;
  • Experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code;
  • Experience with Azure Entra ID for SSO/SAML, enterprise identity, JWT, and RBAC patterns;
  • HIPAA-aware engineering, including encryption, audit trails, minimum necessary access, and careful PHI handling;
  • Healthcare or regulated-data background is strongly preferred;
  • Experience using Claude Code or equivalent agentic tools for end-to-end feature development;
  • Discipline around AI-generated code, including PR-based review, automated test gates, and eval-driven development;
  • Comfort working in a C# + Claude Code loop;

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with vector stores, LLM integration patterns, and prompt evals;
  • Experience with hexagonal architecture, TDD, and clean code instincts;
  • Experience integrating with payer or Medicaid systems;
  • Experience with feature flag systems such as LaunchDarkly or PostHog;
  • SOC 2 or StateRAMP experience;
  • Experience working in a PE-backed scale-up environment with steering-group cadence.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.

title: Executive Director - WKHS Grant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Executive Director serves as the chief operational officer for the Wisdom Keepers, Hope Seekers (WKHS) project, a five-year, multi-institutional initiative funded by Lilly Endowment Inc. to strengthen Black theological education and build sustainable pathways for faith leadership across seven Historically Black Theological Institutions (HBTIs). This position reports directly to the Principal Investigator (Dean Kenyatta Gilbert) and is responsible for day‑to‑day project management, strategic implementation, partnership coordination, and programmatic excellence across all three pathways.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for making recommendations for the project in the areas of compensation, staff selection, disciplinary actions, complaints, staff performance appraisal and similar supervisory duties. Plans, assigns, and evaluates the work of subordinates for effective operation and results of the unit. Directly supervises the Program Operations Coordinator and project staff; advises consultants and the WKHS Council.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students and staff of the Howard University School of Divinity and the university at large. External contacts include the seven HBTI partner institutions (Hampton, Payne, Hood, ITC, Shaw, Virginia Union), denominational partners (AME, COGIC, NBC, PNBC, AMEZ, CME, PAW, TFAM), UNCF staff, consultants, evaluators, and Lilly Endowment program officers.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Project Management (40%)
  • Implement the overall WKHS strategic vision in collaboration with the Principal Investigator.
  • Oversee all three project pathways: Faith Leadership Pathways, Ministry Sustainability & Digital Innovation, and Shared Endowment Fund.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project timelines, deliverables, and milestones.
  • Convene quarterly strategic planning sessions with multi‑institutional partners.
  • Monitor project progress against goals and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with Lilly Endowment grant requirements and Howard University policies.
  • Prepare and coordinate quarterly progress reports and annual narrative reports to funders.
  • Coordinate with Howard University Office of Sponsored Programs on financial compliance.
Partnership & Collaboration Management (30%)
  • Serve as primary liaison to seven HBTI partner institutions.
  • Facilitate WKHS Council meetings and governance structures across multiple institutions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with denominational partners and UNCF.
  • Manage subaward agreements and ensure partner institution compliance and reporting.
  • Facilitate annual convenings and biennial conferences bringing together 30+ stakeholders.
Program Development & Implementation (20%)
  • Oversee Faith Leadership Laboratories across 10 participating institutions/denominations.
  • Direct Summer Bridge Intensive programs and Pathways Resource Materials development.
  • Ensure quality implementation of Digital Repository, AI Peer Learning Cohorts, and Digital Faith Narratives Collection.
  • Oversee Continuing Pastoral Education and Wisdom Keepers Wellness Programs.
  • Monitor Graduate Student Research Grants, Church Impact Initiative Grants, and Faculty Innovation Fellowships.
Fundraising & Sustainability Planning (10%)
  • Support endowment campaign planning and strategy development.
  • Coordinate cultivation events and donor engagement activities.
  • Identify and pursue additional funding opportunities to sustain project initiatives.
  • Develop sustainability plans for program continuation beyond the grant period.
Perform other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Effective leadership and management skills with strategic thinking and systems‑level planning.
  • Deep understanding of Black church traditions, HBCU contexts, and theological education landscape.
  • Expertise in project management methodologies and grant compliance requirements (Uniform Guidance, 2 CFR 200).
  • Strong financial management and budgeting skills for large complex grants ($1M+ budgets).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including report writing and public speaking.
  • Skill in program development, execution, and evaluation.
  • Documented success as an innovator and creative problem solver across multi‑institutional contexts.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with staff, faculty, students, university officials, denominational leaders, and the general public.
  • Cultural competency and sensitivity to HBCU and Black church traditions.
  • Proficiency with project management software, data systems, and collaborative technologies.

Minimum Requirements

Master’s degree in Theology, Divinity, Higher Education Administration, Business Administration, Nonprofit Management, or related field required; Doctorate (Ph.D., D.Min., Ed.D., DBA) preferred. Minimum 7 years of progressive leadership experience in higher education, theological education, or nonprofit management, including at least 3 years managing multi‑institutional partnerships or collaborative initiatives and demonstrated experience managing complex grants or funded projects ($1M+ budgets). 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure: $90,000-100,000

description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of accreditation services for designated client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working closely with Client Group Managers, Accreditation Systems, Security, Venue teams, and other functional areas, the role focuses on data accuracy, process execution, stakeholder support, and operational readiness.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring that client group accreditation applications are processed correctly, access rights are applied accurately, and services are delivered in line with FIFA accreditation policies and service standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Group Support & Coordination
    • Support accreditation delivery for assigned client groups, such as volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners, workforce, or other tournament stakeholders.
    • Assist in collecting, reviewing, and validating client group accreditation data in line with eligibility criteria and submission timelines.
    • Maintain regular communication with client group contacts to provide guidance on accreditation requirements, processes, and deadlines.
    • Coordinate closely with Client Group Managers to support overall client group readiness and service delivery.
  • Accreditation Process Execution
    • Support the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including application tracking, data validation, approval support, badge status monitoring, and distribution preparation.
    • Assist with the accurate assignment and verification of access rights in accordance with FIFA zoning concepts, venue access matrices, and security protocols.
    • Monitor application progress and highlight issues, inconsistencies, or risks to the Client Group Manager.
  • Stakeholder & Functional Area Support
    • Assist in liaising with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to communicate accreditation guidelines and data requirements.
    • Support the preparation of guidance materials, instructions, and training documentation for client groups and venue teams.
    • Provide operational support to venue accreditation teams as required.
  • Event-Time Operations
    • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points during test events and tournament time.
    • Assist with client service at accreditation centres, including troubleshooting data issues and supporting badge collection processes.
    • Support coordination with Security, Venue Operations, and Accreditation Operations teams to address access‑related issues promptly.
    • Escalate operational issues or irregularities to the Client Group Manager in a timely manner.
  • Reporting & Documentation
    • Maintain accurate records of client group accreditation statistics, issues, and resolutions.
    • Support regular reporting on volumes, progress, and operational status.
    • Assist with post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

Your Profile

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent experience in Event Management, Operations, Sports Administration, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in accreditation, event operations, data coordination, or client‑facing roles.
  • Experience working in major events or large‑scale operational environments is an advantage.
  • Exposure to accreditation systems or access control processes is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • Strong data handling and administrative accuracy.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, time‑critical, and multicultural environments.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and online collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Overview

Department: Partnerships & Media

Position

The Content Services Liaison Manager will report jointly to the Zurich-based FWWC Content Services Project Lead. The successful candidate will be responsible for the planning and coordination of all event‑related video content production, as well as ensuring the successful delivery of pre‑event and in‑tournament video content to FIFA stakeholders. The Content Services Liaison Manager will be the in‑country point of contact for all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives or stadium authorities and FIFA’s Media Partners in relation to non‑live content services. The successful individual will work closely with the FIFA Content Services team at FIFA HQ, Zurich to develop content strategies for the event, as well as communicating the confirmed content plans (long‑form, short‑form, social, audio) to all relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include 1 year to go, the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, 100 days to go and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and long operational hours. The selected candidate will also be expected to **escalate** risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee all pre‑event content production based on the overall tournament content‑plan developed in close collaboration with the FIFA Content Services Team in Zurich.
  • Ensure all content creation and delivery for the tournament is communicated clearly and promoted to all stakeholders.
  • Liaise with the FIFA team in Zurich around the creation and distribution of all future content. Report all developments to the Head of Production and work closely with all areas of the FIFA content team.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts to ensure they are informed about and engaged with all filming projects and that their individual content requirements are taken care of.
  • Potentially liaise with the North‑ and South American Medial Partners (MP) to coordinate the delivery of produced content, discuss long and short‑form programming opportunities and social media packages and assets – to be done in conjunction with FIFA Zurich.
  • Investigate new North and South American based opportunities around potential long and short‑form programming, branded content, social media and audio projects, including podcasts.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for FWWC content services related topics within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Content Services Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to support the FIFA Content Services Project Lead based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office.
  • Work closely with the local Host Broadcast and Media Partnerships department as their main point of contact for any FIFA Content Services related topics.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and supervision of the content production for the Play off Final tournaments, the Final Draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • A strong background in editorial sports television production or sports television production management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a producer or production manager in a comparable content production related role within a fast‑paced environment involving complex projects – ideally at a similar international sports event.
  • A knowledge of and participation in the South American Sports TV industry.
  • Contacts within the national football associations in South America.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized and proven to be cool‑headed under pressure.
  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global.

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Automação e Dados Industriais para se juntar ao nosso team de Dados & IA. O profissional será peça-chave na integração estratégica entre as áreas de Tecnologia da Operação (OT) e Tecnologia da Informação (IT) na Eneva.

O objetivo principal desta função é projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis, gerenciar a implementação de ferramentas de dados industriais e disponibilizar dados estratégicos do chão de fábrica para o nosso ambiente analítico, gerando valor e insights para as operações, com foco especial nos processos de nossas usinas térmicas.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Projetos de Automação: Liderar o projeto de centralização de telas do Centro de Operações Integradas (COI), coordenando as atividades com as equipes de automação de nossas diversas localidades.
  • Arquitetura e Integração: Colaborar com as equipes de TI e Automação para desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de integração, discutir a liberação de protocolos e firewalls, garantir a conectividade e gerenciar a disponibilização de servidores.
  • Mapeamento de Processos e Geração de Valor: Aplicar conhecimentos de engenharia de processos para mapear as rotinas e demandas das equipes de Operações e Engenharia, identificando oportunidades onde o uso de dados pode gerar maior eficiência e valor.
  • Plataforma de Dados Industriais: Atuar na implementação e sustentação da plataforma Cognite Data Fusion para contextualizar e enriquecer os dados industriais, facilitando o acesso e a análise.
  • Disponibilização de Dados: Ser a ponte entre o chão de fábrica e o ambiente analítico, garantindo que os dados corretos sejam capturados na origem e disponibilizados de forma estruturada para consumo das áreas de negócio e ciência de dados.
  • Estratégia OT/IT: Contribuir ativamente para a estratégia de integração entre OT e IT, promovendo o uso de tecnologias e arquiteturas que garantam escalabilidade, segurança e governança.

Qualificações Essenciais

  • Formação em Engenharia de Automação, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com a suíte PI System (AVEVA), incluindo desenvolvimento e arquitetura.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em protocolos de comunicação industrial (ex: OPC-UA, Modbus) e conceitos de rede e segurança para ambientes de automação.
  • Experiência em projetos que envolvam a integração entre sistemas de automação (OT) e sistemas corporativos (IT).
  • Capacidade de mapear processos de negócio e traduzir as necessidades das áreas operacionais em requisitos técnicos e de dados.
